title: Not enjoying the new look
body: Hi, I love the app, but I’m really really not enjoying the latest update.. Could you please bring back the old view for “Home” tab?? Where we can see the full week record?? It’s much easier for us to record & see full week record…
author: Floccoli

title: highly recommended!
body: this app has helped me a TON by keeping my routine up. I appreciate the reminders a lot, it helps keep me on track! I definitely would recommend this to any others out there struggling to maintain their routines. this is the perfect app for that! thank you so much for making such a wonderful app.
author: Victoria Townsend
